title: Kishtwar killings aftermath: Remarks by Congress’ Karra, BJP’s Parihar spark protests in J&K

ai.summary: Congress leader Karra and BJP legislator Parihar's remarks about SPO killings in Kishtwar sparked protests in J&K, with BJP members burning effigies and religious groups condemning mosque involvement claims.

facts.claim: two SPOs were killed reportedly by the Army in a mistaken identity case on November 11
facts.quote: two SPOs were killed reportedly by the Army in a mistaken identity case on November 11

facts.claim: The Congress is spreading misleading information to shift the blame from terrorists to our security forces
facts.quote: The Congress is spreading misleading information to shift the blame from terrorists to our security forces

facts.claim: The SPOs were on duty and travelling to an Army post at Dharna-Marwah to relieve the jawans posted there
facts.quote: The SPOs were on duty and travelling to an Army post at Dharna-Marwah to relieve the jawans posted there

facts.claim: BJYM leader Arun Prabhat said, 'It shows the hearts of Congress beat for Pakistan'
facts.quote: It shows the hearts of Congress beat for Pakistan

facts.claim: Ms. Parihar claimed 'announcements were made from the mosques in Kishtwar’s Dachhan area to identify the targets'
facts.quote: announcements were made from the mosques in Kishtwar’s Dachhan area to identify the targets

facts.claim: Ruling National Conference (NC) legislator Tanvir Sadiq said the BJP must be 'held accountable for its MLA’s deeply irresponsible and inflammatory allegations against a mosque in Jammu'
facts.quote: the BJP must be 'held accountable for its MLA’s deeply irresponsible and inflammatory allegations against a mosque in Jammu'

ai.background_note: Congress and BJP leaders made conflicting claims about the cause of two SPOs' deaths in Kishtwar, leading to protests and accusations of communal targeting.
